requirement: Pickup impossible above 0.5m, through blocker, or before drop settles.
reason_not_promoted: The Godot runtime gate is not reproducible. It passed three consecutive runs and then failed, and the cause is a client behaviour the gate cannot control, not a test defect.

blocker.summary: ground_loot_pickup_client submits its own CONFIRM_DROP_SETTLED from local physics, including its own reachability observation, which overwrites the authoritative reachable flag. In headless that observation is almost always false.
blocker.consequence: A gate precondition of reachable=true survives only when the client happens to agree. Three green runs were that coincidence; the fourth timed out on SETTLED_PROJECTION_TIMEOUT.
blocker.not_a_test_defect: The same three assertions pass deterministically against the identical Stage16A core when no Godot client is attached.
blocker.open_design_question: Should the client be able to declare a drop unreachable at all, or should it report geometry only and leave reachability to the authority? That is a client-contract decision, not a gate decision.

above_0_5_m.live_transport_proof: PICKUP_DISTANCE_EXCEEDED observed over HTTP in the Godot gate run (FAR_SERVER_REJECTED)

gate_rework_delivered.best_result: 53/53 PASS, stderr 0 bytes, exit 0, three consecutive runs
gate_rework_delivered.subsequent_result: FAIL SETTLED_PROJECTION_TIMEOUT on the fourth run
fixes_that_hold: Command results matched by command_ref instead of arrival index. The bridge queues commands, the ground-loot client submits its own settles and every completed command triggers a snapshot, so index matching silently paired a check with another command's result.

Drop distances built by moving the player between gathers. ground_loot_pickup_client anchors its iso->Godot mapping on the first snapshot and never re-anchors, and the player node follows client locomotion rather than the authoritative transform, so presentation distance is |drop_iso - anchor_iso|.
Auto Pickup turned off through the authority instead of asserted as a world precondition.
Inventory counted through inventory_projection.routing, because an equipped Bag becomes the effective inventory owner and the base inventory never changes.
Snapshot reads taken after the authoritative result instead of by arrival index.

environment_findings: Gates linger 240 s on PASS (andromeda/gate/success_linger_s). Headless runs should pass -- --gate-success-linger=0.
The persisted development world accumulates Ground Loot, Auto Pickup state and combat damage across runs. Evidence runs need an archived var/ and a fresh world.
next_action_required: Decide the client reachability contract. Until ground_loot_pickup_client stops overwriting authoritative reachability with a headless-unreliable observation, G16B-04 cannot have reproducible real-Godot evidence.
